name: Kira
self_text: I’m Kira, early 30s, non‑binary, from Mexico, and I love swing dancing when I’m not behind a camera. I shoot with a Nikon and I’m only looking for a practice session working on specific shots. I keep a fast pace, which is how I enjoy it. I don’t want to debate gear, and I’m not doing any post‑processing lessons this time. I’m fine with not taking portraits of each other. I’m available most weeks on Sunday afternoon, Sunday morning, or weekday evenings.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with a moderate pace or a fast pace. I'd strongly prefer that you are okay with not taking portraits of each other, though it's not a requirement. A small bonus if you are into a practice session working on specific shots or a relaxed photo walk.
